name: reverse-engineering
description: Defensive reverse engineering workflows for source repositories, binary triage, IOC extraction, Android API extraction, Ghidra headless analysis, and parity review.

interface.shortDescription: Static-first RE workflows with evidence-backed outputs.
interface.longDescription: A local plugin for authorized reverse engineering of source repositories, binaries, Android packages, Ghidra analysis outputs, IOCs, unpacking assessments, and recovered-code parity reviews. Workflows are static-first, evidence-backed, and gated before executing untrusted code.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this repo deeply and export a corpus.
Extract traceable IOCs from this evidence.
